resource_and_duration: Four stages totaled 600.198 prompt-active seconds. Every guarded stage sampled normal pressure level 1 with zero swap growth. Two Build timeouts and the invalid evaluator boundary mean this is not green 45-60 minute endurance.
disposition: STOP this fixture. Preserve the raw failure and partial model diff; do not operator-edit it into a pass or reuse it as a fresh candidate. Raw grader output and checker paths remain outside future candidate workspaces. Behavior-level feedback alone is useful but not a filesystem security boundary; a genuinely independent future run needs evaluator material inaccessible to the candidate, such as a separate protected account or enforced OS sandbox.
next_blocker: Establish a real candidate/evaluator filesystem boundary while keeping the existing OpenCode/oMLX harness, then run a fresh Task12 fixture with bounded stages and external browser/source checks. No release or frontier-equivalence claim.
